description: Per-character lists of trap actor Blueprint asset names used by the character's traps; consumed as a battle preload source rather than as per-trap tuning data.

ID.simple: Row key referenced from Character::Id_CharacterTrap entries.
ID.technical: FName primary key (ImportKeyField=Id in the export). BattleAssets_Traps_12BCE80 iterates Character::Id_CharacterTrap, skips None and resolves each entry against CharacterTrapDataTables (DTM +0x4C0).

FileName_BP.simple: Array of trap Blueprint asset names to preload for the character.
FileName_BP.technical: TArray<FName>, row +0x10, values such as TR_040_00_BP. The asset collector appends the entire array to the battle preload/prepare asset-name list; the row provides no trap stats, sockets or spawn rules. Missing rows are ignored. This is the only identifiable direct consumer in the reconstructed source, so no further runtime behavior is claimed.

notes: Export contains 5 rows with up to ten FileName_BP slots each; most slots are None.
Distinct from TrapDataTable (DTM +0x670), which is used for the track-sequence/voice trap lookups; this table's only observed use is character asset collection.
Single table asset 'CharacterTrapDataTable' loaded into DTM +0x4C0; no shards or localization variants in the export.
Reconstructed source with cited retail RVAs; Blueprint-only consumers and uncooked assets are out of scope.

usages.detail: Resolves the trap row and appends FileName_BP to preload lists.
